title: Subagents in parallel, approval before a slow step
about: A fire captain asks about two houses at once.

vars.brief: I'm a fire captain. Compare how smoke would spread in these two houses and which bedrooms are hardest to reach.

steps.say: One brief, two houses: the main agent hands each house to its own subagent, and they run at once.
The agents work at once; the smoke model is slow, so the agent stops and asks first.

else.say: The agent is offline, so the escape routes run as a tool.

steps.say: An approval card for each slow step. The person decides.

else.say: No approval was needed this time: the smoke runs were already approved here.

steps.label: Run it
steps.say: Approved. The paused turn carries on from where it stopped.
Each subagent writes its findings into the same workspace.
The bedroom that is hardest to reach, on camera.
